parameters.name: AppID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the whiteboard application ID, refer to [CreateApp](~~204234~~).

parameters.name: ServiceParameters
parameters.description: The parameter set required by the moderation service, in JSON string format. The text content input parameter is content (String), the custom data ID is DataId (String), and the cache type is CacheType (String, valid value: ephemeral).

parameters.name: Stream
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use streaming output.
